words.definition: Interference by a state in another's affairs
words.definationTranslation: Ek rashtra dwara dusre ke maamlon mein dakhal dena

sentence.sentence: The international community debated the necessity of military intervention.
sentence.translation: Antarrashtriya samudaay ne sainy hakshep ki aavashyakta par bahas ki.

sentence.sentence: Humanitarian intervention aims to protect civilians during a crisis.
sentence.translation: Manavtavadi hakshep ka uddeshya sankat ke dauran nagrikon ki raksha karna hota hai.

words.definition: The practice of conducting negotiations between nations
words.definationTranslation: Rashtraon ke beech baatcheet karne ki pratha

sentence.sentence: Diplomacy is an important tool for resolving conflicts between countries
sentence.translation: Deshon ke beech sangharsh suljhane ke liye Kootneeti ek mahatvpoorna tool hai

sentence.sentence: The diplomat used diplomacy to negotiate a peace treaty
sentence.translation: Raajdoot ne shanti sandhi par baatcheet karne ke liye Kootneeti ka upyog kiya

words.definition: The process of international integration arising from the interchange of world views, products, ideas, and other aspects of culture
words.definationTranslation: Vishvaik drishtikon, utpaad, vichaar, aur sanskriti ke anya pehluon ka adan-pradan utpann hone wali antarrashtriya ekikaran ki prakriya

sentence.sentence: Globalization has increased international cooperation and trade
sentence.translation: Vishwaikaran ne antarrashtriya sahyog aur vyapaar ko badhaya hai

sentence.sentence: The impact of globalization on local cultures is a topic of debate
sentence.translation: Sthaniya sanskritiyon par vishwaikaran ka prabhav ek vivadit vishay hai

words.definition: Involving more than two nations or parties
words.definationTranslation: Do se adhik rashtron ya pakshon ka sammilith hona

sentence.sentence: Multilateral agreements are an important aspect of international cooperation
sentence.translation: Bahupakshiya samjhauton ka antarrashtriya sahyog ka ek mahatvpoorna pehlu hai

sentence.sentence: The multilateral trade agreement was signed by several countries
sentence.translation: Bahupakshiya vyapaar samjhauta kai deshon dwara parhith kiya gaya

words.definition: The authority of a state to govern itself
words.definationTranslation: Ek rashtra ka apne aap par shasan karne ka adhikaar

sentence.sentence: Sovereignty is a fundamental principle of international law
sentence.translation: Swarajya antarrashtriya kanoon ka ek mool sidhant hai

sentence.sentence: The country's sovereignty was threatened by the foreign invasion
sentence.translation: Videshi aakraman dwara desh ka swarajya khatre mein tha

words.definition: A formally concluded and ratified agreement between nations
words.definationTranslation: Rashtron ke beech ek aadhikarik roop se niye gaye aur mastishkrit samjhauta

sentence.sentence: The treaty was signed by several countries to promote international cooperation
sentence.translation: Antarrashtriya sahyog ko badhava dene ke liye kai deshon dwara sandhi par hastakshar kiye gaye

sentence.sentence: The treaty marked the end of the war between the two nations
sentence.translation: Sandhi ne do rashtron ke beech yudh ka anth ka sanket kiya

words.definition: An international organization that aims to promote peace, security, and cooperation among its member states
words.definationTranslation: Ek antarrashtriya sangathan jo apne sadasya rashtron ke beech shanti, suraksha, aur sahyog ko badhava dena chahta hai

sentence.sentence: The United Nations plays a crucial role in maintaining international peace and security
sentence.translation: Sanyukt Rashtra antarrashtriya shanti aur suraksha banaye rakhne mein ek mahatvpoorna bhoomika nibhata hai

sentence.sentence: The United Nations has been involved in several humanitarian missions around the world
sentence.translation: Sanyukt Rashtra duniya bhar mein kai manavta ke mishnon mein shaamil raha hai

words.definition: The act of working together for a common goal or purpose
words.definationTranslation: Ek saamanya lakshya ya uddeshya ke liye saath meh kaam karna

sentence.sentence: International cooperation is essential for addressing global challenges
sentence.translation: Vishva sthar ke chunautiyon ka samna karne ke liye antarrashtriya sahyog aavashyak hai

sentence.sentence: The cooperation between the two countries has led to significant economic benefits
sentence.translation: Do deshon ke beech sahyog ne mahatvpoorna aarthik laabh ke liye naye raaste khole hain

words.definition: The set of rules and principles that govern the relations between nations
words.definationTranslation: Rashtron ke beech sambandhon ko niyantrit karne vale niyam aur sidhanton ka samuh

sentence.sentence: International law provides a framework for resolving disputes between nations
sentence.translation: Antarrashtriya kanoon rashtron ke beech vivadon ka samadhan karne ke liye ek dharancha pradan karta hai

sentence.sentence: The international law has been effective in promoting cooperation and stability among nations
sentence.translation: Antarrashtriya kanoon ne rashtron ke beech sahyog aur sthirta ko badhava dene mein prabhavi sabit kiya hai

words.definition: The official residence or office of a diplomat or ambassador
words.definationTranslation: Ek raajdoot ya ambassador ka aadhikarik nivaas sthal ya karyalay

sentence.sentence: The embassy provides assistance to citizens of its home country
sentence.translation: Dootavas apne desh ke nagrikon ko sahaayata pradan karta hai

sentence.sentence: The embassy is responsible for promoting the interests of its home country
sentence.translation: Dootavas apne desh ke hiton ko badhava dene ke liye jimmedar hota hai

words.definition: The act of moving to a new country to live and work
words.definationTranslation: Naye desh mein rehne aur kaam karne ke liye jaana

sentence.sentence: Immigration has become a major issue in international relations
sentence.translation: Pravas antarrashtriya sambandhon mein ek bada mudda ban gaya hai

sentence.sentence: The country has introduced new rules to regulate immigration
sentence.translation: Desh ne pravas ko niyantrit karne ke liye naye niyam laye hain

words.definition: The community of all nations and peoples around the world
words.definationTranslation: Duniya bhar ke sabhi rashtron aur logon ka samudaay

sentence.sentence: The global community is working together to address global challenges
sentence.translation: Vishwa samudaay vishva sthar ke chunautiyon ka samna karne ke liye saath meh kaam kar raha hai

sentence.sentence: The global community has made significant progress in reducing poverty
sentence.translation: Vishwa samudaay ne garibi ko kam karne mein mahatvpoorna pragati ki hai

words.definition: The sharing of ideas, customs, and values between different cultures
words.definationTranslation: Vibhinn sanskritiyon ke beech vichaaron, rite-riwaazon, aur maulyon ka adan-pradan

sentence.sentence: Cultural exchange programs have been established to promote understanding between nations
sentence.translation: Rashtron ke beech samajh ko badhava dene ke liye sanskritik adan-pradan karyakram sthaapit kiye gaye hain

sentence.sentence: The cultural exchange has helped to break down stereotypes and misconceptions
sentence.translation: Sanskritik adan-pradan ne kutarkon aur galatfahmiyon ko todne mein madad ki hai

words.definition: The study of the interactions between nations and other actors on the world stage
words.definationTranslation: Rashtron aur anya abhinetaon ke beech sambandhon ka adhyayan

sentence.sentence: International relations is a complex and dynamic field of study
sentence.translation: Antarrashtriya sambandh ek jatil aur gati shil kshetra hai

sentence.sentence: The international relations have been shaped by a variety of factors, including politics, economics, and culture
sentence.translation: Antarrashtriya sambandhon ko rajniti, arthashastra, aur sanskriti samet vibhinn kaarakon dwara aakaar diya gaya hai

words.definition: The privilege of being exempt from the jurisdiction of the host country's courts
words.definationTranslation: Mezbaani desh ke nyayalayon ke adhikaar ke adheen na hone ka visheshadhikaar

sentence.sentence: Diplomatic immunity is an important principle of international law
sentence.translation: Kootneetik suraksha antarrashtriya kanoon ka ek mahatvpoorna sidhant hai

sentence.sentence: The diplomat enjoyed diplomatic immunity and was not prosecuted for the crime
sentence.translation: Raajdoot ko kootneetik suraksha ka anand tha aur use aaparadh ke liye abhiyukt nahin kiya gaya

words.definition: The use of economic penalties to influence the behavior of a country or organization
words.definationTranslation: Ek desh ya sangathan ke vyavhar ko prabhavit karne ke liye aarthik dand ka upyog

sentence.sentence: Economic sanctions have been used to pressure countries to change their policies
sentence.translation: Aarthik pratibandh deshon par dabav daalne ke liye upyog kiye gaye hain ki ve apni nitiyon mein badlaav karen

sentence.sentence: The economic sanctions had a devastating impact on the country's economy
sentence.translation: Aarthik pratibandhon ka desh ki arthvyavastha par vicarankarak prabhav pada

words.definition: The exchange of goods and services between countries
words.definationTranslation: Deshon ke beech vastuon aur sevaon ka adan-pradan

sentence.sentence: International trade has increased significantly in recent years
sentence.translation: Antarrashtriya vyapaar haal ke varshon mein mahatvpoorna roop se badh gaya hai

sentence.sentence: The international trade has created new opportunities for businesses and consumers
sentence.translation: Antarrashtriya vyapaar ne vyavsayon aur upbhoktaon ke liye naye avasar paida kiye hain

words.definition: The study of the relationship between politics and geography
words.definationTranslation: Rajniti aur bhugol ke beech sambandh ka adhyayan

sentence.sentence: Geopolitics plays a crucial role in shaping international relations
sentence.translation: Bhugolik rajniti antarrashtriya sambandhon ko aakaar dene mein ek mahatvpoorna bhoomika nibhata hai

sentence.sentence: The geopolitics of the region is complex and influenced by various factors
sentence.translation: Kshetr ki bhugolik rajniti jatil hai aur vibhinn kaarakon dwara prabhavit hoti hai

words.definition: The basic rights and freedoms that all human beings are entitled to
words.definationTranslation: Manav adhikaar jo sabhi manushyon ke liye mahatvpoorna hain

sentence.sentence: Human rights are universal and inalienable
sentence.translation: Manav adhikaar sarvjanik aur avinaashi hain

sentence.sentence: The protection of human rights is a fundamental principle of international law
sentence.translation: Manav adhikaaron ki raksha antarrashtriya kanoon ka ek mool sidhant hai

words.definition: The protection of a country's interests and citizens from external threats
words.definationTranslation: Ek desh ke hiton aur nagrikon ki baahari khatron se raksha

sentence.sentence: International security is a major concern for many countries
sentence.translation: Antarrashtriya suraksha kai deshon ke liye ek bada chinta ka vishay hai

sentence.sentence: The international security has been threatened by terrorism and other global challenges
sentence.translation: Antarrashtriya suraksha aatankvaad aur anya vishva sthar ke chunautiyon dwara khatre mein hai
